operators.name: sum_dim1
semantics: Reduces input tensor x over dimension 1 (the channel dimension of size 3), preserving the order of the remaining dimensions. Output shape is [N, H, W] where N=batch, H=height, W=width.
Matches torch.sum(x, dim=1) without keepdim; the resulting tensor is contiguous with stride [H*W, W, 1].
Input must be a CUDA float32 tensor, can have arbitrary strides; the kernel handles strides internally by reading via given strides or by requiring contiguous input (binding will ensure contiguous).

operators.name: log_softmax_dim0
semantics: Applies log_softmax over dimension 0 (batch dimension) for each (h, w) location independently. For each spatial index (h, w), computes log(exp(x[i,h,w]) / sum_{j=0}^{N-1} exp(x[j,h,w])) across all N batch elements.
Equivalent to torch.log_softmax(x, dim=0). Output shape identical to input [N, H, W], dtype float32, device cuda.
Numerical stability uses the max-subtraction trick: m = max over dim 0, then log(sum(exp(x-m)))+m
Input must be a CUDA float32 tensor with shape [N, H, W] and can have any strides; the binding will ensure contiguous layout if needed.
Output is a new tensor with the same shape and stride as the contiguous input.
Sums input x of shape [2048, 3, 256, 512] over dimension 1, producing a tensor of shape [2048, 256, 512] and dtype float32 on CUDA.
The result is stored in variable x, replacing the original input for subsequent operations.
No keepdim, so the output is a 3D tensor with stride [256*512, 512, 1] (contiguous).
Applies log_softmax over dimension 0 on tensor x of shape [2048, 256, 512], producing a tensor of the same shape and dtype.
The softmax is computed independently for each (h,w) spatial location across the batch dimension.
Output tensor is stored in x.
Returns the final tensor after both operations, shape [2048, 256, 512], dtype float32, device CUDA.
